input:
The differential equation of all parabolas, whose axes are parallel to Y-axis, is

Options:
A. y3 = 1
B. y3 = 0
C. y3 = -1
D. y.y3 + y1 = 0

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the differential equation representing the family of all parabolas whose axis is parallel to the y-axis.

given_information.family: Parabolas with axis parallel to y-axis

phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Start from the general parabola form with axis parallel to y-axis and eliminate constants by differentiation.

key_formulas.third_derivative_goal: Differentiate enough times to remove h, k, a

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Differentiate the general parabola equation repeatedly and eliminate parameters.

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: The third derivative vanishes for every parabola of the form (x-h)² = 4a(y-k), so the family equation is y''' = 0.
